claims.sourceText: The Sol Foundation, inaugural conference page
claims.text: The inaugural conference was held 17-18 November 2023 at Stanford University, sponsored by the Nolan Laboratory (Department of Pathology) and the Stanford School of Medicine; speakers included Eric Davis, Tim Gallaudet, Avi Loeb, Leslie Kean, Charles McCullough III, Christopher Mellon, Karl Nell, Diana Pasulka, Hal Puthoff and Jacques Vallee.
